decision: Use Common Paper for SaaS (CSA + order form), services (PSA + SOW), NDA, DPA, BAA and AI Addendum. Set governing law and venue deliberately: India for Indian clients, the client's state for US enterprises if they insist. Have a lawyer review the cover-page variables once.
details: Standard US-style terms ignore Indian stamp duty and arbitration practice; verify with a lawyer.

verify.note: Standards page confirms CC BY 4.0. It lists the CSA, PSA, mutual NDA, DPA, BAA, AI Addendum, SLA, Pilot, Design Partner, ToS, plus SOW and Order Form.
